query:
INSERT INTO user_profiles (user_id, display_name, bio, accent_color, updated_at)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now())
           ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
           SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name,
               bio = EXCLUDED.bio,
               accent_color = EXCLUDED.accent_color,
               updated_at = now()
